decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (3025-601 Rev $,3025-600 Rev $, 3849-23 Rev $, 3849-24 Rev $,  3849-22 Rev $, 3849-17 Rev 01, 3849-13 Rev 01,  3849-11 Rev 01, 3849-12 Rev 01
Received 23/1/15

3489-28 rev $, 3489-27 rev $, 3489-26 rev $, 3489-25 rev $, 3489-30 rev $, 3489-29 rev $
Received 27/1/15) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site outside the following times: 0800 to 1800 on Mondays to Friday and 0900 to 1300 on Saturdays nor at any time on Sundays, Bank or Public Holidays.

Condition : 4 - The premises hereby approved, shall only be used for self-storage with ancillary offices, and notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, as amended, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification, the use shall not be changed to another warehousing (use class B8) use with ancillary offices.

Condition : 5 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no additional floor space above 6180 square metres (gross internal area) shall be formed within the building hereby permitted and the use of the building shall not be changed to any other use class.
Condition : 6 - The building hereby permitted shall not be open to customers on any day outside the following times: 0600 to 2300 hours.

Condition : 7 - During construction works a wheel-washing system shall be provided to remove mud, stones and any other extraneous materials from the wheels and chassis' of construction vehicles exiting the site and all loads of
construction materials, excavation spoil or other such matter shall be fully covered in order to ensure that no material leaves the site attached to the vehicle which might subsequently be deposited on the highway.

Condition : 8 - The exit from the wheel washing system shall be constructed from a hard, non-porous surfacing material and sited as far away from the exit to the highway as is possible given the constraints of the site and the surface shall be kept clean at all times. Waste water discharged from the wheel washing system shall be stored and disposed of on site and shall not be discharged into the public sewerage system without prior removal of soil, stones and any other suspended material.

Condition : 9 - Suitable measures to minimise dust nuisance caused by the operations and to ensure that no dust or other debris is carried on to the adjoining properties shall also be provided in accordance with the guidance at www.london.gov.uk/mayorienvironmentlair qualityklocs/constructiondustbpg.pdf and site lighting shall be designed, positioned and directed so as not to  unnecessarily intrude on passing drivers on public highways and so as not to direct light into any windows of properties outside the site.

Condition : 10 - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied: The local planning authority shall be notified immediately of any additional contamination discovered during the course of the development. A competent person shall assess the additional contamination, and shall
submit appropriate amendments to the scheme for  decontamination in writing to the local planning authority for approval. The agreed scheme for decontamination, including amendments, shall be fully implemented
and a written validation (closure) report submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.

Condition : 11 - The building shall not be occupied or used until details of the renewable energy technologies to be installed on the site have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The renewable energy technologies shall provide for no less than a 20 percent reduction in carbon emissions from the total energy needs of the development. The approved renewable energy technologies shall be installed before any part of the building hereby permitted is first occupied and shall be operated in accordance with the approved details thereafter.

Condition : 12 - Hard and soft landscaping works and arboricultural work shall be carried out in accordance with details approved by 01094/22/P8(5ii,16i) on 24 December 2013, and all landscaping shall be completed in accordance with these details prior to the first occupation of the building and shall be maintained in accordance with those details thereafter.

Condition : 13 - Materials to be used in the construction of external surfaces and finishes of the building, including the 'green wall' hereby approved, shall be in accordance with the details approved by 01094/22/P8(3i, 15 and 17i) on 30 January 2014, and the landscaping shall remain as approved and maintained permanently thereafter.
Condition : 14 - All deliveries to the site during construction shall accord with the Construction Logistics plan of the details approved by 01094/22/P8(3i, 15 and 17i) on 30 January 2014.

Condition : 15 - On-site drainage shall be carried out in accordance with the details approved by 01094/22/P8(3i, 15 and 17i) on 30 January 2014, and all drainage works shall be completed prior to the first occupation of the building hereby approved and shall be maintained in accordance with those details thereafter.

Condition : 16 - A visibility splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of all means of access to the site, the depth measured from the back of the footway and widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence,
wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.
description: Variation of condition 2 (Approved Plans) to alter the boundary treatment, building footprint, Internal reconfigurations, roof plant and minor elevation details following planning application 01094/22/P8 approved under appeal reference APP/F5540/A/11/2143993 dated 08/06/2011 for the erection of a self storage buildings (Class B8) with associated parking, access and landscaping.
